name: Canonical Chirality-Seed Time-Shell Gravity Fiber Test
definition: PD-DM-012 is retyped onto a canonical chirality-seed contrast input. The only direct-readout question remains whether the existing G_TS fiber separates this explicit persistent-continuity contrast rather than annihilating it.
math: D_chi c_*=2c_*; Delta(deltaC)_P=-w_eff D_chi c_*=-2w_eff c_* !=0. Test G_TS(x_vis-w_eff D_chi c_*) != G_TS(x_vis) on the selected admissible fiber.
